gen_coco_panoptic_test_info_main: run the script to generate COCO panoptic test image information JSON from val and test-dev annotation files
gen_coco_panoptic_test_info_parse_args: run the argparse parser to accept a COCO annotation directory path for panoptic segmentation test info generation
gen_coco_panoptic_test_info_load_annotat: load panoptic_val2017.json and image_info_test-dev2017.json annotation files from the COCO data root directory
gen_coco_panoptic_test_info_merge_catego: merge categories with isthing attribute from panoptic val annotations into the test-dev image info file
gen_coco_panoptic_test_info_dump_output: dump the merged test image information with panoptic categories to panoptic_image_info_test-dev2017.json
